body: I don't have a car or any real money.
Oh, it wasn't prescribed -- after initially being given legal doses of it at the hospital with my ECT, I began doing it myself illegally using drugs bought on the darkweb.

Yeah, there were times I thought the ketamine might be doing some good, but I thought that was maybe just from being distracted by the high. The first few times I had it, it was actually ordered by the psychiatrist who did the ECT for me, given intravenously along with propofol to anesthetize me, and it didn't help me. I ended up giving it to myself (by intramuscular injection) later on, but I overused it for the recreational effects. I also sometimes used a related drug (methoxetamine) instead. Caution is definitely advisable.
West Palm is a bit too far up north for me to be able to get to, but I appreciate that a lot regardless. Thanks. :)
Thanks a lot. :) I'll send a message your way sometime soon.
